theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: Despite top momentum rank and trend-gate eligibility, overweight is conditional on cohesion: the current narrow breadth (0.17) means leadership is fragile. If breadth improves, the trend is more robust; if not, the overweight case weakens. No crowding flag, so no fade signal. We lean overweight only as a disciplined continuation of the trend, not a prediction.
evidence: breadth 0.167 (low) – narrow participation is a concern
theses.dissent: A narrow advance can quickly reverse if the few leading stocks correct; with no ETF to score, the theme’s direction is harder to verify, and the historical edge is only in drawdown avoidance, not return forecasting.

falsifier.text: If the theme’s 10-day relative return vs. Hang Seng is negative and breadth drops below 0.10, the overweight lean is invalidated.
